rules.check: The CV gives at least one way to be contacted: a phone number, an email or another contact.
rules.explain_mn: Ажил олгогч тантай холбогдож чадах ёстой. Утасны дугаар эсвэл и-мэйл хаягаа бич.
rules.explain_en: An employer has to be able to reach you. Add a phone number or an email address.

rules.check: No register number, home address, photo or family details. Red for under-18s, yellow otherwise.
rules.explain_mn: Регистрийн дугаар, гэрийн хаяг, зураг, гэр бүлийнхээ тухай мэдээллийг CV-дээ бүү бич. Хэн нэгэн буруугаар ашиглаж болно. 18 хүрээгүй бол энэ нь ялангуяа аюултай.
rules.explain_en: Leave your register number, home address, photo and details about your family off your CV. Someone could misuse them. If you are under 18, this matters even more.

rules.title_en: A job allowed at your age
rules.check: For an under-18, the target job is not on Order A/122 (same lists as the contract rater's M08). On the list is red; cleared is green; anything else is unknown.
rules.explain_mn: 18 хүрээгүй хүнд хориглосон ажилд орох гэж бүү оролдоорой. Ажлаа гэрээ шалгагчаар шалгуулаарай.
rules.explain_en: If you are under 18, do not apply for a job prohibited for children. Check the job with the contract checker.

rules.check: At least `min_matches` of the skills the CV lists match the target job's skill words.
rules.explain_mn: Зорьж буй ажилд тань хэрэгтэй ур чадвараа тодорхой бич.
rules.explain_en: Name the skills the job you want actually needs.

rules.check: At least one piece of experience, counting jobs, volunteering, school projects, a family business and herding.
rules.explain_mn: Туршлага гэдэгт ажил төдийгүй сайн дурын ажил, сургуулийн төсөл, гэр бүлийн бизнест туслах, мал маллах ч орно. Бүгдийг нь бич.
rules.explain_en: Experience is not only jobs: volunteering, school projects, helping in a family business and herding all count. Write them down.

rules.check: The CV names a school, a course or a level of education.
rules.explain_mn: Сурч буй эсвэл төгссөн сургууль, анги, сургалтаа бич.
rules.explain_en: Write the school, grade or course you are in or have finished.

rules.check: The CV lists at least one language.
rules.explain_mn: Мэддэг хэлнүүдээ, хэр сайн мэддэгээ бич.
rules.explain_en: List the languages you know and how well.

rules.check: At least one achievement quotes a number (decided in code: the excerpt contains a digit).
rules.explain_mn: Амжилтаа тоогоор харуулбал итгэл төрүүлнэ. Жишээ нь «өдөрт 40 захиалга хүргэсэн».
rules.explain_en: Numbers make an achievement believable, for example "delivered 40 orders a day".

rules.check: Between `min_words` and `max_words` words (about one to two pages).
rules.explain_mn: CV 1–2 хуудас байхад хамгийн тохиромжтой: хэт богино бол мэдээлэл дутна, хэт урт бол уншихгүй.
rules.explain_en: One to two pages is best: too short leaves things out, too long goes unread.

rules.check: The CV names a referee or says references are available on request.
rules.explain_mn: Тодорхойлолт өгөх хүн (багш, өмнөх ажил олгогч) байвал бич, эсвэл «хүсэлтээр өгнө» гэж бич.
rules.explain_en: Name someone who can vouch for you (a teacher, a past employer), or write "available on request".

rules.check: The model quotes no misspelled words. AI judgment: yellow at most.
rules.explain_mn: Үсгийн алдааг засаарай — ажил олгогч анхаарна.
rules.explain_en: Fix spelling mistakes — employers notice them.

rules.check: The model reads the tone as suitable for a job application. AI judgment: yellow at most.
rules.explain_en: Write in a polite, clear, formal way.
